explanation: Joining the single currency in the first wave meant hitting the Maastricht numbers on deficit, debt, inflation and rates in the reference year 1997, and then defending the decision in public. The government this election produced made that its main commitment and was in office for exactly the years the test covered. The atlas argues the politics rather than the arithmetic. The convergence had been under way since 1992 under the previous majority, and the direction did not change in 1995. What changed is that the party which had opposed the Maastricht ratification now owned the target.
